title: A standalone server serves the shared hub behind HUB_SERVE, and another reads it before paying Google; a removal reaches the reader's cache through the revocation feed even with no read quota
steps: S1: Three standalone apps on scratch databases: a hub (HUB_SERVE=1), client one (HUB_URL, HUB_TOKEN, HUB_CONTRIBUTE=1), client two (HUB_URL, HUB_TOKEN). Client one researches place A with a fake Google, then its hub tick sends the contribution; the hub runs its verify and publish ticks.
S2: Client two researches the same place A.
S3: The hub removes the business (suppressBusiness); client two's read quota is set past its limit; client two runs its hub tick and builds the brief research of A.
S4: A client's feed cursor is older than the hub keeps (410 cursor_expired).
S5: The hub CLI blocks an account, withdraws a contribution, revokes and removes a place and revokes a picture.
expect: S1: client one pays Place Details once; the hub reads Google once to verify and publishes 1 snapshot; only identity, name, phone, address and location observations reach the hub.
S2: client two makes 0 Place Details calls; its google-places source has coverage.provenance = hub and the hub's name and address.
S3: the cached hub copy has dto null and revoked_at set; the brief research has no googlePlace, no google-places source and hubRevoked of length 1.
S4: every cached place is checked again; one the hub no longer serves is revoked, one it cannot check now is not used, the cursor moves to the head.
S5: each command exits 0 and the account, observation, place and picture change state; a revocation without --reason exits 2.
evidence: Before: the hub modules existed and were tested, but no server mounted their doors or ran their ticks, and no client read them
fence: createStandaloneApp mounts createHubService under HUB_SERVE and passes createHubLink to the place runner under HUB_URL; briefResearchOf leaves out facts of revoked hub copies

tests: without HUB_SERVE the hub doors are not mounted
a place researched once is shared
only the closed field list leaves a client
a business removed on the hub leaves the client cache
an expired cursor re-checks the cache
hub facts carry only fields the hub chose
an operator blocks and unblocks an account
